description: This Java class defines a static dataset of cheese names, providing methods to retrieve the list and generate random subsets. It serves as placeholder or dummy data within an Android application.

classes.name: Cheeses
classes.description: A utility class that holds an array of cheese names and provides methods to access the list and generate random cheese selections.

methods.name: asList
methods.description: Returns an ArrayList containing all cheese names defined in the CHEESES array.

methods.name: randomList
methods.description: Generates and returns an ArrayList of a specified count of randomly selected unique cheese names from the CHEESES array.
